scope: Rejected far-transfer fallback after an initially unloaded target instance

finding.before: MapManager preflight does not construct an unloaded bound instance. SafeTeleport then constructs it and removes the player from the source world. If actual InstanceMap admission rejects at WorldPortAck, the existing homebind fallback can have the source mapId. SafeTeleport classified that fallback as near using mapId alone, although the Player had already been removed from the world.
finding.reproduction: Actual native DestroyInstance unloads empty B while group saves retain its ID. Preflight passes without creating B; transfer creates B; corpse-instance admission rejects at ACK. Reference logs far0 near1 world0 change0 dest1220 corpse1. A near ACK does not perform AddPlayerToMap.
finding.fix: Require IsInWorld as well as matching mapId and ordinary options before using the near branch. An out-of-world same-map fallback now follows the existing full far-transfer protocol and native map admission/AddPlayerToMap at the subsequent ACK. Homebind selection and corpse-instance rejection are unchanged.
